contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade (a one-page landing page for 'lumina.' with a hero, a mock dashboard card, a marquee strip and three feature cards). The footer labels it 'Fictional product · Impeccable design-pattern example', so it is a specimen page; it is judged here as the layout that ships. English only (html lang en at every width), no market named. No right-to-left language.
overall_reason: The page is static HTML that reads fully without script, weighs almost nothing and has a phone layout at 650px; its one brittle slot is the rotated 'BUILT DIFFERENT.' sticker, which covers the mock window's title and pushes the page 9px past the screen at 375.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT, T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB and T-HOSTILE-CONTENT pass, and T-WIDTHS fails once on the sticker over the window bar at 375 and 1440 (ROB-009, with the sweep's ROB-003 overflow Floor).

findings.title: Nothing overlaps, is sliced or hides under chrome
findings.where: Hero mock dashboard, div.dashboard-wrap > div.sticker ('BUILT DIFFERENT.') over div.window-bar > span 'YOUR_NEXT_BIG_THING.exe', 375 and 1440px
findings.evidence: At 375 the absolutely placed sticker spans x 263 to 383 and y 644 to 764 (dom-375), on top of the window-bar title at x 204 to 342, y 700. tiles/375-00.png shows the title cut to 'YOUR_NEXT_BI'; tiles/1440-00.png shows the same title half under the sticker. The sticker's 8px past the viewport makes the page 384px wide at 375, which the sweep's overflow detector records as a ROB-003 Floor.
findings.before: A rotated sticker placed at a fixed offset over the top-right corner of the window card, with no room reserved and no clip.
findings.after: Move the sticker inside the card's right padding (inset-inline-end: 0 and a negative top only), or clip the hero with overflow: clip, and right-align the window title away from it.
findings.why: The sticker hides the card's title and makes the phone page scroll sideways by a few pixels, and any longer title is hidden further.

strengths: All 730 characters are in the HTML and stay visible with scripts off, with an observer that never fires and with reduced motion.
The page weighs about 1 KiB known over 5 requests, with an LCP of 360 ms in the lab, and draws its icons and sticker as inline SVG.
A 650px breakpoint stacks the hero, the dashboard card and the feature cards one per row at 375 (tiles/375-00.png to tiles/375-02.png), and the buttons keep their labels on one line.
The long token 'YOUR_NEXT_BIG_THING.exe' (23 characters) stays inside its 138px box at 375 (long_unbroken_strings).
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names were judged from layout evidence.
A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record).
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: async found no primary actions, and no image failed.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: the mock card's '75%' is fixed sample copy.
At 375 the two nav links ('The good stuff', 'How it works') are hidden with no menu; they are in-page anchors to sections a phone reader scrolls to anyway.
One stylesheet was cross-origin and unreadable; its rules are unknown, not absent. Capture prep blocked /js/detect-antipatterns-browser.js, the host's overlay script.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
